description: The I03213-6 (Ashton-under-Lyne) extraction of the 25 Sep 1832 christening. Names John and a mother Mary — and NO father. CAPTURED LIVE 2026-08-13, verbatim. Two fixtures rather than one wildcard, because the two extractions genuinely differ in what they name and that difference is the point of the test: enumerating the batch is what surfaces the father. The earlier hand-authored wildcard returned a father-less record for EVERY recordId, so in run v1_2026-08-14_00-56-33 the skill read the father persona three times and could never find him. The `~JMF4-CL` predicate deliberately matches both JMF4-CL9 and JMF4-CLS: those are two personas of the same record and the live API returns the same document for both, so re-reading is correct behavior, not a loop.
